# TsugaPostgresMonitoring

**API:** `observability.tsuga.com/v1alpha1` · **Scope:** Namespaced · **Short name:** `tspg`

Monitor one PostgreSQL server through a dedicated collector forwarding to the cluster agent. Requires TsugaCollectorConfig named `cluster`. Use one resource per server: the database role `otel_monitor` is shared. Include `provisioning` explicitly; managed mode requires an admin Secret, while manual mode requires DBA setup. Resource names are limited to 43 characters. See the [DBM guide](../kubernetes-monitoring/dbm.md).

| `spec.host` | string | Yes | — | DNS name or IPv4 address of the server: a Service in-cluster, or the managed endpoint. It is spliced into libpq DSNs, so the pattern keeps out spaces, '=' and newlines, and requires dot-separated RFC 1123 labels (a dotted-decimal IPv4 address is a valid label sequence). maxLength: `253`; pattern: `"^[A-Za-z0-9]([A-Za-z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?(\\.[A-Za-z0-9]([A-Za-z0-9-]{0,61}[A-Za-z0-9])?)*$"` |
